title: What makes cooperation satisfying, and what changes when it disappoints?

interpretations.title: Positive co-op and puzzle appreciation appear together
interpretations.claim: Within recommended reviews, players positive about co-op are more likely to express positive sentiment about puzzle design and difficulty. This may reflect enjoyment of shared problem-solving rather than multiplayer presence alone.
interpretations.basis: Compare positive puzzle-design and difficulty sentiment within recommended reviews: positive co-op cohort versus all other recommended reviews.
interpretations.limitations: Review-level association; the two tags need not describe the same moment. Not a causal claim.

interpretations.title: Co-op criticism accompanies wider puzzle dissatisfaction
interpretations.claim: Among non-recommended reviews, negative co-op sentiment frequently coincides with negative puzzle-design sentiment and comparisons to earlier games. Some reviewers describe diminished interdependence or uneven participation.
interpretations.basis: Compare negative puzzle-design and series-comparison sentiments within non-recommended reviews, split by negative co-op sentiment.
interpretations.limitations: Some references concern franchise expectations; semantic ambiguity must remain visible. No causal inference.
